app.title: NYAYAVANTA-AI
app.subtitle: Indian Legal Assistant
app.tagline: AI-Powered Indian Legal Information & Research Assistant
app.disclaimer: Informational and research assistance only. Not formal legal advice.
app.disclaimer_full: Nyayavanta provides AI-generated legal information and research assistance based on statutory Bare Acts and judgments. It is not formal legal advice or a substitute for an Advocate. Always verify critical matters with authoritative legal counsel.
app.core_principle: Don't make AI look magical. Make its evidence visible.

dashboard.hero_title: Understand the Law. Find the Authority.
dashboard.hero_subtitle: AI-powered Indian legal information and research assistance grounded in authentic Bare Acts, statutory sections, and landmark Supreme Court precedents.
dashboard.search_placeholder: Ask a legal question (e.g. Can landlord forfeit deposit?)...
dashboard.supported_domains_desc: Specialized statutory retrieval and claim grounding for 4 core domains.

consumer.title: Consumer Complaints
consumer.desc: Defective goods, deficiency in service, unfair trade practices, E-Daakhil filing procedure.

tenancy.title: Rental / Tenancy Disputes
tenancy.desc: Security deposit withholding, eviction notices, lease deeds, Rent Court summary jurisdiction.

employment.title: Employment Disputes
employment.act: Payment of Gratuity Act & ICA Sec 27
employment.desc: Unpaid salary, statutory gratuity delays, non-compete restraint unenforceability, SAMADHAAN portal.

contract.title: Contract Disputes
contract.desc: Commercial breach, Section 73/74 damages, MSME Samadhaan 45-day statutory payment recovery.

chat.ask_question_title: Ask a Specific Indian Legal Question
chat.ask_question_desc: Describe the dispute facts, consideration quantum, or terms. Nyayavanta connects statements to Bare Acts and Supreme Court decisions.
chat.sample_prompt_1: "Landlord withholding deposit of Rs 80,000 after vacation in Bengaluru."
chat.sample_prompt_2: "Can my employer enforce a post-employment non-compete clause in India?"
chat.sample_prompt_3: "Buyer refusing to pay overdue MSME invoices beyond 45 days."
chat.input_placeholder: Describe your Indian legal question or situation in detail...

evidence_panel.title: Evidence & Grounding
evidence_panel.awaiting_desc: When you submit a query, Nyayavanta retrieves statutory provisions and case law citations, verifying all claims here in real time.
evidence_panel.bare_acts_desc: Sections mapped from BNS, BSA, CPC, ICA, and CPA.
evidence_panel.precedents_desc: Supreme Court and High Court precedent ratios.
evidence_panel.audit_desc: Every statement tagged as Verified or Conflicting.

search.title: Legal Corpus Search

cases.subtitle: Authoritative precedents with ratio decidendi and citation mapping.
